note: avis de non-renouvellement de Google reçu le 10 décembre 2025 ; contrat de services du 26 octobre 2015 prolongé jusqu'au 30 avril 2026 puis expiré ; segment Search fermé et présenté en activités abandonnées (People Inc., anciennement IAC Inc.)
quote: On December 10, 2025, the Company received a notice of non-renewal (the "Notice") from Google Inc. of the services agreement, dated October 26, 2015 and as subsequently amended (the "Services Agreement"). As a result of the Notice, the Services Agreement was due to expire on March 31, 2026; the Services Agreement was extended through April 30, 2026, at which point the Services Agreement expired.

note: fin du contrat de services avec Google : arrêt du segment Search
quote: In connection with the expiration of the Services Agreement the Company ceased operations of its Search segment, which are presented as discontinued operations within the Company's consolidated financial statements for all periods presented.
